lines.en: I decide to check out the local porn shop because...well, it feels a lot more empowering to actually purchase porn rather than just browsing for it online.
Besides, I have no idea when the next time I'll have sex is...so this will suffice in holding me over in the meantime.
Also, who doesn't love porn? There is absolutely no way this trip could possibly go wrong.
: Welcome in. Please take your-
: Ah?!
A [young_girl] at the front desk calls out to me, but abruptly stops for some reason.
I take a quick look around the store to see if maybe she's reacting to someone else but quickly confirm that it must have been something I did.
What, though? I've only been inside for like, five seconds.
: We...are closed!
: But the sign outside said you were open for another two hours.
: That sign is old! Please leave now!
I make my way over to the counter as I'm tired of shouting across the room and the girl immediately shields her face.
She looks to be the age of one of my students, so I don't hold it against her for getting embarrassed about working in a place like this-
But she should at least be somewhat helpful to customers, shouldn't she?
Or...maybe this is another one of those no males around type of deals that I heard Ami talk about?
If this girl doesn't have any experience helping male customers...
Well, honestly, that just makes me want her help even more.
: What...uh...
: What can I...do for you?...
: Wait a minute...
: Of course...take as long as you-
: Aah!
: Un...Unhand me right now! I'll call the cops! I mean it!
: ...Makoto?
: Nope! No Makoto's here! You must be confusing me for someone else!
: You look completely different without your glasses on.
: Never mind my glasses! What the Hell are you doing in here, Sensei?!
: You know what kind of store this is, don't you?
: I'm actually just stopping by to give you your homework. I looked up your address in the school registry.
: Wait...really? But I could have sworn-
: That was obviously a lie. I'm here to buy porn.
: Can't you just use the Internet for that sort of thing?! That's what everyone else does!
: Can you really afford to be saying that as the employee of a porn shop?
: No!
: I mean...yes?!
: I mean-
: I don’t know what I mean!
: Listen, I get that it's probably embarrassing to be seen somewhere like this by your teacher...but I'm not going to hold it against you.
: This is your family's business, right? I think it’s admirable that you're helping out here.
: Now, can you please point me toward the teen section?
: That's it. I am going to kill myself tonight.
: Oh come on. Isn’t it better to be dealing with me than some random guy?
: Honestly?...
: No. No, this is ten times worse.
: This might be shocking news for you, but teachers watch porn too.
: That doesn't mean I have to be okay with it!
: Now that you know I work here it...it changes everything!
: I'm supposed to be the diligent one! The one who always follows the rules and...doesn't sell vibrators five nights a week!
: You can be whatever you want to be. If selling vibrators empowers you, I'll even buy one. Right now.
: For what?! Stop making this even weirder for me by being okay with it when it is obviously very, very wrong!
: For what it's worth, it wouldn't make any difference to me if you worked here or some fast food restaurant. A job is a job and you just happened to wind up with this one.
: Well...thank you, Sensei. That's-
: In fact, I implore more girls your age to work in places like this. Because not only would it bring more customers in, it would help-
: Okay, you know what? Just...pick something and get out. It's clear that arguing about this is going to somehow negatively affect our relationship, and I would very much prefer to not do that.
: Great. So what do you recommend?
: Huh?
: Me?
: Yeah. What’s the big ticket item here? What should I buy?
: You’re...asking me for recommendations?
: Yeah. You're the porn expert, aren't you?
: My mom is the expert...I just kinda...you know...
: Ahh. So you're just a porn hobbyist.
: No...I am a normal girl.
: Normal girls watch porn and you shouldn't be ashamed to admit that you do too.
: It’s not that I don’t...it’s just not something I planned on talking about to you.
: But it's the first thing we've realized that we have in common with one another.
: We have plenty of other things in common! We're both intellectuals! We both wear glasses! We both-
: Have a series of tags we gravitate toward when we're alone in our rooms. I understand you.
: No, I really don't think you do...
: Listen, your secret’s safe with me. Don’t worry. Just give me a recommendation and I’ll be on my way.
: After that, we can forget this little meeting ever happened.
That obviously isn't true. I plan on coming here all the time.
I'm just not going to let Makoto know that since I don't actually want her to kill herself tonight.
: Umm...
: Well...I...kind of need to know what...sort of things you're into to be able to recommend anything...
: Are you asking me what turns me on right now?
: I...guess so?...
: Makoto, I am your teacher. You can't just ask me things like that.
: What is this horrible side of you and why am I just finding out about it now?!
: I'm just kidding. You can ask me about my turn-ons whenever you want.
: I repeat! What is this horrible side of you and why am I just finding out about it now?!
It looks like I'm going to have to give Makoto a little more info as to what I'm looking for.
The only issue is what exactly I'm going to tell her.
: Let's see...
: I'm looking for-
Mature/MILF Porn
: Do you have anything with mature women?
: Like...ones around your age? Or...older?
: How much older do you have?
: How much older do you want?...
: I'm not sure. I've never really thought about it before.
: So you're just...taking a shot in the dark here?
: An educated shot. I know what I'm in the mood for. But I am trusting you to make the final decision.
: Please never come here again after tonight.
Makoto walks over to a rack near the wall and checks out a few DVDs.
: Umm...Sensei...do you have a preference for...you know...breast size?
: Up to you, Makoto. I appreciate all breasts equally.
: How kind of you...
Makoto searches around for another minute or two before eventually returning to the counter without anything in her hand.
Student/Teacher Porn
: Do you have anything involving a teacher and a student?
: Involving what?!
: A teacher and a student. Or students. No more than ten, though.
: Oh, and if you can find any with glasses, that would be much appreciated.
: There is...absolutely no way you don't understand how this sounds!
: Oh, I know exactly how this sounds. I'm just interested in seeing how you handle this revelation.
: What is happening to my life all of a sudden?
: Oh, come on. This is a totally normal thing for someone in my position to fantasize about.
: Don't pretend you haven't thought about it from the other side of things.
: What goes on in my mind is for me and me only! I don't need you of all people trying to figure out what goes on in there!
: All I'm saying is that the two of us aren't so different. And that you should be happy I'm interested in girls like you.
: It's not that I'm not happy...
: It's just...a lot to take in at once...
: Don't worry. I'll go slow.
: I wonder if I should leave a suicide note...
Makoto walks over to a rack near the wall and starts checking out a few DVDs.
: Sensei...all of the girls I'm seeing with glasses...look a tiny bit too close to me...
: Perfect. I'll take them all.
: A-All of them?! Just how much free time do you have?!
Makoto begins shoveling all of the student/teacher DVDs she can find into her arms...only to put them all right back and return to the counter minutes later with absolutely nothing.
The weirdest shit you've got
: Well, this isn't easy to talk about, but...
: I’m not really into...'conventional' pornography.
: And...what does that mean exactly?
: You not understanding just means you haven’t been tainted by the evils of the world yet.
: The...evils of the world?...
: But how is that supposed to help me find-
: You know what? Just do a couple laps around the store and grab me the weirdest thing you can find.
: Ugh...
Makoto walks over to a rack near the wall and checks out a few DVDs.
Most of them wind up being immediately put back onto the shelves but, every once in a while, Makoto finds something of note and runs it by me.
: Sensei...This one has a chicken on the cover...
Unfortunately, it's never enough.
: Is...Is that okay?
: Weirder, please.
: Weirder than a chicken?...
Makoto looks through a few more rows of DVDs before coming back without anything in her hands.
: Yeah, I tried...but I really can't do this.
: I think it might be better if you just use the Internet after all...
: How about you just follow me around the store and I point out all of the stuff I'm interested in?
: That sounds like it would work, right?
: Oh, and maybe after that, you could show me all of the stuff you're interested in and-
: Oh, look at the time! We’re closed!
: No you're not. It's only been like ten minutes since I walked in and-
: Thanks for stopping in, Sensei! It was nice seeing you!
: Please never come back and forget where I work now!
Makoto begins pushing me to the door, but I refuse to leave this place without any porn.
In a desperate attempt to avoid leaving empty-handed, I reach out and grab the first DVD I see on the way out of the shop.
: Hey! You can't just-
: Ugh, never mind! Just take it! I’ll pay for it myself!
I give up resisting once I have something in my hands and Makoto is eventually able to push me outside, quickly locking the door behind me.
: Goodnight, Sensei! You were never here and neither was I!
: Goodnight, Makoto. See you tomorrow night.
: I sure hope not!
Left alone with nothing but my new DVD and the night sky, I glance down to inspect the cover.
: “After School Service: Student Council Punishment Games”
: I can work with this.
Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
